source: wiki: Dungeons & Bosses + equipment, pets, mounts, mount skins
_comment: Dungeon -> Boss -> drops (highest chance first) + normal_drop (T1-T8 equipment tiers, no chance on the wiki). Dungeon boss names come from manual/bosses.json ("???" = not written yet; bossDrops there split a dungeon's drops between its loot bosses, the final boss is listed last); bossBarHash / bar / model / bones from bossbars.json. lootKey = loot group (FAQ -> Loot Information, label / damage threshold in loot_info.json). chance = percent per kill (fragments can be > 100). kind = fragment / item (equipment, has id + rarity) / material (crafting material, not in the equipment scan) / mountSkin / pet / mount. id = item id, model = its item model (dropped on the ground / in chat sprites). name = the equipment / pet / mount scan's spelling. "All <rarity> Items" (each) is expanded to the equipment of that rarity from the dungeon (from = each). Shiny drops share the normal item's boss: chance / 50 (irradiated), / 40 (gilded), / 30 (other rarities). "Realm" = minibosses and bosses outside a dungeon. aliases = in-game location name -> dungeon name here.
